description: Run link extraction over a filtered set of wiki pages. Inserts/updates rows in the server-side wiki_links graph for pages where the on-write hook missed (e.g. legacy pages, ingest backfill). Requires at least one of tags or folder. Returns { pagesConsidered, pagesProcessed, linksExtracted }. pagesConsidered is every page matching the tags/folder filter; pagesProcessed is the subset that was stale and got re-indexed. pagesProcessed=0 with pagesConsidered>0 means every matching page was already up to date — that is success, not failure. pagesConsidered=0 means the filter matched no pages at all.
name: extract_links
